gold.text: The industrial designer and user interface designer will redraw the remote to match the reduced-cost, one-control design; the recorded drawing was revised during the meeting.

system.text: The device will use five push-buttons plus one integrated scroll-wheel push-button.
The menu button will also perform the OK function.

gold.text: Use one integrated scroll-wheel/pushbutton and no separate buttons, with functions accessed through the LCD; detailed click/hold/menu behavior was not fully settled.
The group initially disagreed about which features and controls to cut; it settled on retaining the LCD, removing speech, simplifying controls and using cheaper casing/power choices.

The industrial designer questioned whether mixed positive/negative wording invalidated the mean score. Marketing explained the intended positive criteria and the industrial designer accepted that explanation within the meeting.
